arguments.analyst: Observed evidence shows large gains from surface/loop changes R73H:E90V:D117G (3.867) and E95G:E172V (3.856), while S30P-based and multi-substitution combos collapse (1.30). Menu predictions cluster ~3.58; favor double substitutions near the E95G/Q80R/V112E neighborhood and avoid proline-bearing clusters.
arguments.hypothesis: Substitutions at positions 95 and 112/117 (E95G, E95V, V112M, D117G) individually or in pairs raise log brightness above 3.6, whereas S30P/N170D or T50S:K52E-type pairs do not.
